text:
anya: Quick heads-up — saw NDCG@10 drop when we switched to passage-split for onboarding model r3. Any ideas?
sasha: saw that too yesterday. numbers?
anya: ml-bot uploaded a short summary.
ml-bot: uploaded eval artifact: https://ci.redwood/infer/artifacts/1745556666/r3-passages-vs-docs.csv — summary: nDCG@10: doc=0.412 -> passage=0.378; MRR@1: doc=0.294 -> passage=0.286.
jing: interesting. could be truncation or loss of cross-passage signals. what was avg doc length?
anya: avg doc tokens ~820, passage size 256, overlap 25%.
tom: could also be a quantization x granularity interaction — int8 PTQ seems noisier on short local contexts.
sasha: propose 3-arm AB: 1) doc-level scoring, 2) passage-first scoring, 3) hybrid-rescore (passage candidates then doc-rescore topK). stratify by query length + doc length.
jing: agree. also toggle prefix caching and batching to see cost/latency tradeoffs.
anya: I'll run a quick smoke. command I used:
```bash
python eval.py --model r3-onboard --quant int8 --split passage --passage-size 256 --overlap 64 --topk 100 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10
```
ml-bot: started run 1745556672; ETA ~25m
ops-bot: FYI latency will ~2x for hybrid-rescore @topk=50 on dedicated nodes (measured).
tom: for analysis compute delta_by_query_length buckets: short|medium|long; aim for >=2k queries per bucket for stat power.
sasha: also check candidate-ordering artifacts — passage-ranking orders by local relevance which can scramble doc-level rank; include candidate-normalization (title boost / doc-prior).
jing: small but important: ensure offline eval tokenizer matches runtime tokenizer — last safe commit is 7b3a9b.
anya: good call. also freeze serving config (batching, kvpack) when comparing models so we measure model diff not infra diff.
ml-bot: results uploaded 1745556950: hybrid-rescore improved NDCG@10 on long queries (+0.022) but regressed on short queries (-0.015). int8 quant amplifies the short-query regression by ~30%.
sasha: ok, suggests we need hybrid + quant-aware calibration OR fallback to doc-rescore for short queries.
tom: proposed experiment plan overnight: 1) hybrid + quant-calib (per-layer bias correction); 2) passage-size sweep (256, 384) w/ overlap 64/128; 3) tokenizer anchor audit + rerun on matched tokenizer. can we queue these?
anya: I'll queue them and tag follow-ups. tagging @sasha @jing for triage. :thumbsup:
sasha: thanks — will add metric slices (nDCG@1/5/10, MRR@1/5), statistical significance (paired bootstrap) and sample-level diffs for inspection.
jing: will prepare candidate mapping dump for inspection (doc_id -> passage_offsets).
anya: sounds good. will post links when jobs finish.
